name: poll2_clutch
caption:
CHOOSE YOUR STARTER: CLUTCH SHOOTER 🎮🏀 Last shot, game on the line. Who's taking it for us?

1️⃣ Kawhi Leonard, the shot: 4 bounces to beat Philly 92-90 in Game 7, 41 points, back with us now
2️⃣ OG Anunoby, buzzer-beater: a three at the horn to beat Boston 104-103 in Game 3 of the 2020 second round
3️⃣ Ja'Kobe Walter, today: game-winning three at Orlando with 0.5 seconds left, 40.9% from three last season

Comment 1, 2 or 3 👇

facts.claim: Game 7 vs 76ers, May 12, 2019: Leonard's shot bounced off the rim 4 times before falling for a 92-90 win, first Game 7 buzzer beater in NBA history; 41 points
Kawhi Leonard: 2x NBA Finals MVP (2014, 2019); No. 2 for Toronto (2018-19); back with Toronto in 2026
Anunoby hit a game-winning buzzer-beating three-pointer on Sept 3, 2020 in a 104-103 win in Game 3 of the Eastern Conference semifinals (second round) vs Boston; it prevented a 0-3 deficit
March 4, 2025: Walter hit the game-winning three with 0.5 seconds left in a 114-113 win at Orlando; drafted by Toronto in 2024, with Toronto 2024-present
